bibl.title: Variation in Expressing Temporal and Aspectual Distinctions in Complement Clauses: A Study of the Greek Non-Literary Papyri of the Roman Period.
bibl.seg: Jerneja Kavčič, Variation in Expressing Temporal and Aspectual Distinctions in Complement Clauses: A Study of the Greek Non-Literary Papyri of the Roman Period.

Klaas Bentein, Mark Janse & Jorie Soltic (edd.), Variation and Change in Ancient Greek Tense, Aspect and Modality = Amsterdam Studies in Classical Philology. 23 (Leiden - Boston, 2017) pp. 22-55, figg.
